name: battery

name: air_temp
source: 21 1A@4, same temperature scale

name: ext_temp
source: 21 1A@8; external temperature sensor. The sensor is NOT present on the Td5 ECU (RDL016) → constant 0x1088 = 150.0 °C, a phantom reading. Confirmed in the car 2026-08-21: actual outside temp ~17 °C (the car's own cluster sensor via BCU), so 150 = false. Limits [-40,50] set so 150 is flagged suspect/struck-through. The value means nothing.

name: fuel_temp
source: 21 1A@12, same temperature scale

name: accel_way1
source: 21 1B@0 u16/1000 V. Track 1: ~0.3–0.5 V at rest → ~4.7 V full throttle. Confirmed against the car.

name: accel_way2
source: 21 1B@2 u16/1000 V. Track 2 moves MIRRORED to track 1: ~4.7 V at rest → 0.3 V at full throttle. Confirmed against the car (way1 low while way2 high).

name: accel_way3
source: 21 1B@4 u16/1000 V; accelerator pedal track 3. PROVEN in the car 2026-08-20: moves 0→2.23 V on application → the car is Euro 3 (NNN). Mirrors way1/way2.

name: accel_supply
source: 21 1B@6 u16/1000 V (5V reference). Should sit rock-solid at 5.0 V ±0.1; a dip = short in the pedal wiring. Verified 5.01 V.

name: manifold_press
source: 21 1C@0 u16/10000 bar = TURBO/boost pressure (reference tool 'Turbo Pressure'). Idle ~1.0 bar (atmospheric); full load 2.0–2.2 bar absolute; the ECU's overboost cut > 2.42 bar. CONFIRMED 2026-08-03 (1.0→1.2 bar).

name: maf_raw
source: 21 1C@4. NOT air mass — car test 2026-08-20: reads 57 at ignition-on and 0 the whole time the engine is RUNNING (opposite of MAF). My earlier 'Air Flow' reclassification was WRONG. Unknown status field. The real MAF LID is STILL UNMAPPED — requires a raw sweep of LIDs while blipping the throttle (differential).

name: rpm_error
source: 21 21@0 s16; idle governor deviation (target − actual). PROVEN: ≈0 at idle (car 2026-08-20: average −4 at 700–900 rpm), grows with engine speed under load (~2150 at 3000 rpm) — expected, only meaningful at IDLE. Not a fault.

name: balance_1
source: 21 40@0 s16; cylinder balance 1. PROVEN (labeled_captures 40='correct'); values −6…+2 across captures.

name: balance_2
source: 21 40@2 s16; cylinder balance 2. PROVEN (labeled_captures 40='correct'); values −6…+2 across captures.

name: balance_3
source: 21 40@4 s16; cylinder balance 3. PROVEN (labeled_captures 40='correct'); values −6…+2 across captures.

name: balance_4
source: 21 40@6 s16; cylinder balance 4. PROVEN (labeled_captures 40='correct'); values −6…+2 across captures.

name: balance_5

name: maf
source: 21 1D byte5 u8 kg/hr — MAF (air mass). FOUND via lid_sweep 2026-08-21: idle 69, 2000 rpm 184, follows load (2.7x). Matches published Td5 reference tool ranges (idle 55-65, 2000 rpm 185-200; overboost-cut ~618-650). NOTE: matched against forum ranges, not read off a reference tool on RDL016 itself. The sensor is HEALTHY (resistance pin1-2=17k OK, 12V on pin3, live follows rpm).

name: injection_qty
source: 21 1D@6 u16 x0.01 mg/stroke = INJECTION QUANTITY. PROVEN (field) via car test 2026-08-21 with deliberate overrun lifts: idle 11.1, load 23.9, OVERRUN 4.7 mg/stroke (falls below idle = fuel cut) = unambiguous fuelling signature. Gives a plausible live economy ~7.6 L/100km. Ekaitza calls 21 1D 'fuel-usage'. NOTE: the exact SCALE (x0.01) is matched against the SimonRafferty reference, not cross-checked against a factory tool on RDL016 — plausible but fine-tunable. Drives the trip computer (fuel_rate/economy, candidate).
